messages:
devin: Quick heads-up — I'm planning a rolling update on inference-deployment to smooth the replica ramp and add burst capacity. Changing TF var `min_replicas` 2 -> 4 and adding `max_surge: 20%` in the k8s strategy. Can y'all eyeball for obvious hazards? PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/482

maria: quick q — if we bump min_replicas to 4 will we double-schedule on small node pools? worried about OOMs during startup.

ajay: if nodes are tight we should also tweak PodAntiAffinity and set `startupProbe` longer. also preStop hook with a short sleep to drain connections helps steady traffic.

linh: FYI we have a secret rotation scheduled tomorrow (kms path change). make sure the deployment uses the new secret key name — don't leave default SA perm. I'll post the replacement secret name in the PR comments.

devin: thanks — planning a canary rollout (10% traffic) first. terraform change will be done in two steps: 1) tf plan in canary workspace, 2) apply when canary healthy.

ajay: +1. suggest we also add `maxUnavailable: 0` for the initial canary so old pods are retained until new ones pass readiness.

maria: if we need to reduce risk we can set `replica-smoothing: 30s` in the deploy controller annotation (we've used that before to avoid bursty autoscaler signals).

linh: posted secret name in the PR. Also make sure the helm values map `secret.path` rather than embedding raw key.

devin: noted. I'll update PR with affinity snippet and preStop. Will run the plan in `canary` workspace and leave apply blocked until @maria and @ajay approve.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan started by devin for branch patch/infra/replica-ramp — plan id plan-20260318-87. (logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/plans/plan-20260318-87)

ajay: when you update PR please add this snippet so ops can reuse it:
```
readinessProbe:
  httpGet: /ready
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  periodSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 6
lifecycle:
  preStop:
    exec:
      command: ["/bin/sh","-c","sleep 8"]
```

maria: acked. I'll run a quick node pressure check and reply here before apply.

devin: perfect — thanks team. I'll wait for both approvals then apply canary and monitor latency/cpu for 20m. If anything odd, rollback and revert tf var change.
